required_before_reading: 40 induction full reviews completed, profile distilled, immutable freeze.json saved; no holdout full review before freeze.
per_paper: Read all main and scientific appendix pages, inspect material figures, save ordinary ten_dimensions and holdout_validation with frozen_profile_sha256 and dimensions keyed exactly as ten_dimensions.

dimension_schema.reason: Evidence-based applicability or exception; not a style-quality score

interpretation: These are conditional organizational suggestions, not obligatory checklist. A source omitting a theorem, using later related work, no fixed contributions, or including legitimate qualified inference is not a failure. Mark nonapplicability for a truly irrelevant choice, contradiction only if frozen advice would require an unsupported/worse rewrite for that evidence.
correction_timing: Save all10 validation records against the same immutable profile before revising runtime advice. Preserve original frozen profile and all exceptions.
remaining_scope: Read-only style assessment, no reproduction of original experiments or formal proof certification; no sample proportions generalized to conference population.
